'''Grug''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] thug. Along with the Trandoshan [[Gurg]], he was hired by [[Len Markus]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] to attack the [[Heroes of Cularin]] in a hangar bay in the town of [[Hedrett]] on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. They killed the courier [[Acan]] with a [[Fragmentation grenade/Legends|Fragmentation grenade]], but they were both killed shortly after by the heroes.
